## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. **Full format set.** `md, txt, html, docx, rtf, pdf, latex` — pandoc produces html/rtf/latex
   (docx unchanged); **pdf goes through Typst** inside the same isolated container (binary dep;
   `check:licenses` exception already recorded for `typst`). `substack` is a `profile: 'substack'`
   option on `md`, not an eighth format — recorded in the registry. The container rejects anything
   outside the registry before work begins.
2. **`--citeproc` CSL rendering.** Five CSL styles at MVP — picked the conventional five: **APA,
   MLA, Chicago author-date, Harvard, Vancouver** (recorded here per ticket instruction). Rendered
   from the project's CSL-JSON items (`bibliography/csl.json`, P1.02) + `[@key]` cite nodes in the
   canonical markdown; the style is an export-dialog option; 10 styles is 1.x. Citeproc-js is
   rejected on licence — pandoc's own `--citeproc` (a BSD-compatible engine path) is the route.
   The five `.csl` styles are **Rhema-authored** minimal-but-correct CSL 1.0.2 styles inlined in
   `apps/export/src/csl-styles.ts` (license-clean; the upstream Zotero styles repo is CC-BY-SA
   which is not in the allowlist — authoring avoids a new exception; inlining also frees the
   runtime bundle from a filesystem layout dependency).
3. **Footnote + figure fidelity per format.** Footnotes → real docx/LaTeX footnotes (docx golden
   exists — extend to latex/html/rtf). Figures per REQ-VIZ-15: **SVG for HTML/PDF/LaTeX; PNG@2x
   for docx/rtf; native tables where tables exist; `.txt` keeps alt + caption + source; `alt`
   maps to the format's alt field; the source line exports as a footnote where footnotes exist;
   `[unverified data]` becomes a caption note; `.md` carries spec + data + provenance (a
   figure-sources appendix — the canonical `.md` block itself is byte-faithful); dark renders
   never export.** Consumes P1.13's `figureExportPackage`, never re-derives.
4. **Block-level provenance appendix (REQ-POS-7).** Generated from the version's
   `provenance_map` (PRB.07/P1.02 capture); **off by default, one toggle, granularity labeled
   honestly** ("block-level — blocks edited by the author after drafting are marked *mixed*");
   appendix-capable formats only (html/pdf/docx/latex/md — `txt` omits, `rtf` is outside the
   spec's own enumeration); never promised above block level (REQ-POS-10 keeps span-granular
   export 1.x).
5. **Disclosure surfaces (REQ-GENRE-5 export half + REQ-POS-6 consumption).** Protocol-conditional:
   **Academic** → the disclosure statement surface (the ICMJE template registers with P1.21; the
   dialog surface + generator hook land here and degrade to the general template until then — a
   service, never a gate); **Op-ed** → the exclusivity reminder line in the dialog; the AI-use
   attach toggle (PRB.11) is unchanged.
6. **Whole-account export zip (REQ-ACCT-3).** A worker job builds the zip — every project in its
   on-disk layout (`manifest.md`, `drafts/`, `correspondence/`, `agents/author/*`; `agents/editor/*`
   excluded), every voice (`PERSONA.md`, `docs/`, `profile/` incl. the calibration report), samples
   as canonical markdown, a ledger CSV, and preference-profile rows when they exist. Delivered as an
   **emailed link with a 7-day expiry**; this ticket owns build + delivery + expiry machinery and an
   API route P1.20's Settings trigger calls.
7. **Fresh-account importer + golden round-trip.** Importing the zip into a fresh account
   reproduces every project and voice (REQ-ACCT-3 — golden on the three real projects); importer is
   idempotent (re-import is a no-op).
8. **Isolation + discipline.** Pandoc/Typst run only in `apps/export` — never in api/web images; the
   dialog still shows the open-obligation count with links and never blocks (§11.7); `pre_export`
   horizon surfacing unchanged.
9. **Deterministic verification.** `turbo build lint typecheck` + `pnpm test` green; per-format
   golden fixtures; the zip round-trip golden.

## Plan

1. **Contracts** (`domain/export.ts`): the full registry — 7 formats, `MD_EXPORT_PROFILES`
   (`substack`), `CSL_STYLES` (5 + labels), `PROVENANCE_APPENDIX_FORMATS`, filename helpers.
2. **`apps/export`**: pandoc extraArgs + sidecar files (bibliography/csl/figure bytes), typst-pdf
   path, figure-markdown rewrite per embed, substack profile transform, vendored `csl/*.csl`,
   Dockerfile typst layer, tests. Isolation AC extended to `typst`.
3. **`packages/ai-use`**: statement-template registry (`registerStatementTemplate`,
   `templateForProtocol` consults it, degrades to `general`) + template-keyed headings so P1.21's
   ICMJE template slots in without touching export code.
4. **Provenance appendix renderer** in `packages/mirror` (`provenance-appendix.ts`): spans +
   `splitMarkdownBlocks` excerpts → an honest `## Provenance` markdown appendix (appended
   api-side, like `attachmentSection`).
5. **`packages/archive` (new)**: `buildAccountZip` (projects incl. artifacts minus
   `agents/editor/*`/`.rhema/`/H-kinds, voices incl. persona artifacts, samples, `ledger.csv`,
   `manifest.json` with per-file sha256 + portable `state.json` rows) and `importAccountZip`
   (deterministic `*_imp_<hash>` ids → `on conflict do nothing` idempotency; reproduces projects,
   drafts, artifacts+versions, personas, samples, figures).
6. **Migration `0038_account_export.sql`** + drizzle schema entry + RLS (matching the tenant
   table pattern).
7. **api**: `export-routes.ts` — dialog gains csl styles/hasBibliography/provenance
   toggle/protocol surfaces (integrity norms w/ §6.7 degrade); POST gains `profile`, `cslStyle`,
   `provenanceAppendix`; figure resolution + `figureExportPackage` payloads; bibliography read.
   `account-export-routes.ts` — `POST /account/export` (enqueue worker job), `GET
   /account/export` (status), `GET /account/export/:id/:token` (7-day-gated download), `POST
   /account/import`. Wired in `index.ts` + `env.ts` + api-client DTOs.
8. **worker**: `export-jobs.ts` `account.export` consumer — build zip → content store →
   `account_exports` row (token hash, expires_at) → `auth.mail` email with the link (the mail
   transport pattern already in place; `apiPublicUrl` already in worker env via the notifications
   config).
9. **web**: dialog renders the full format list + `md:substack` radio, CSL-style select (when a
   bibliography exists), provenance toggle (unchecked), exclusivity reminder + disclosure surface
   copy; server passes the new fields; standalone-statement links extended to the full set.
10. Build memory + deferrals + PR.

## Progress

_(chronological; the diff is the source of truth)_

- **Contracts** — `packages/contracts/src/domain/export.ts` rewritten as the single registry:
  `EXPORT_FORMATS` = `md, txt, html, docx, rtf, pdf, latex` (pandoc targets + standalone flags;
  `pdf` rides the pandoc `pdf` writer with `--pdf-engine=typst`), `MD_EXPORT_PROFILES` =
  `{ substack }` (a *profile*, never an eighth format), `CSL_STYLES` = the five MVP styles
  (apa / mla / chicago-author-date / harvard / vancouver + display labels),
  `PROVENANCE_APPENDIX_FORMATS` = `{ md, html, pdf, docx, latex }` (`txt`/`rtf` omitted per
  §8.4's enumeration), `exportFileName`/`aiUseFileName` extended (`.tex` for latex, the profile
  marked in the md filename).
- **`apps/export`** — `pandoc.ts` gained sidecar staging (bibliography JSON + `.csl` + figure
  asset bytes under a per-run temp dir, `--resource-path`, `--bibliography`/`--csl`/`--citeproc`
  args); `export.ts` routes formats, attaches the figure-sources appendix for md, and validates
  profile/style/format combos before any exec; `figures.ts` implements the REQ-VIZ-15 rewrite
  (svg→`assets/figures/<id>/render.svg` for html/pdf/latex, `render@2x.png` decoded for
  docx/rtf, native table pass-through, txt = alt+caption+source lines, `[unverified data]`
  caption note, no-payload marker → alt text, dark render never referenced); `substack.ts`
  strips comments/figure markers and flattens footnotes into a `## Notes` list;
  `csl-styles.ts` inlines the five Rhema-authored CSL 1.0.2 styles; `Dockerfile` pins
  `PANDOC_VERSION=3.10` + `TYPST_VERSION=0.13.1` (official musl-static releases — the only
  image carrying either binary).
- **`packages/ai-use`** — `statement.ts` gained the template registry
  (`registerStatementTemplate` + `templateForProtocol`, degrades to `general`; P1.21 registers
  the ICMJE variant without touching export code); `compose.ts` exposes the template-keyed
  heading so the attached statement matches the standalone one.
- **`packages/mirror`** — `provenance-appendix.ts` renders `## Provenance` from
  `provenance_maps.spans` (keyed by `draft_version_id`, resolved through the draft head's
  promoted artifact version — never by project id): block id + 60-char excerpt via
  `splitMarkdownBlocks` + `provenanceSourceLabel`, honest *mixed* wording for author-edited
  blocks, and the explicit "span-level recorded, not exported at MVP" line (REQ-POS-10).
- **`packages/archive` (new)** — `layout.ts` (manifest v1 + portable `state.json` rows incl.
  §11.7 `preferences` snapshot), `build.ts` (`buildAccountZip`: every project in its on-disk
  layout minus `agents/editor/*`/`.rhema`/internal kinds, every voice incl. `profile/`
  calibration report, samples as canonical markdown, `ledger.csv`, `manifest.json` with
  per-file sha256, deterministic sorted-file zip), `import.ts` (`importAccountZip` into a
  fresh workspace: deterministic `importedId(workspace|kind|originalId)` ids →
  `on conflict do nothing` idempotency; reproduces projects, drafts, artifacts+versions,
  personas, samples, connections, figures, provenance maps).
- **`packages/db`** — migration `0038_account_export.sql` (`account_exports`: workspace/user,
  `building|ready|failed`, zip sha/bytes/object key, **hashed** download token, created/ready/
  expires/downloaded timestamps, error text) + drizzle schema + RLS tenant pattern.
- **`apps/api`** — `export-routes.ts`: dialog DTO gains `profiles`/`cslStyles`/`hasBibliography`/
  `provenanceAvailable`/`surfaces` (protocol-conditional Academic disclosure + Op-ed
  `OP_ED_EXCLUSIVITY_REMINDER`, §6.7 degrade on missing norms row); POST gains `profile`,

- **`apps/worker`** — `export-jobs.ts`: `account.export` consumer — re-reads state,

- **`apps/web`** — export dialog renders all seven formats + `md:substack` radio, CSL-style
